name: execute
description: Execute a sequence of game actions

actions.description: The ordered list of actions to execute on a virtual game controller

value.description: The intensity of the action. It should be 0 or 1 for discrete actions and between -1 and 1 for continuous actions

duration.description: The duration of the action in seconds. That is, the time the button/stick is pressed/held in position

blocking.description: Whether the action should be blocking or non-blocking. If blocking, the next action in the list will start only after `duration` seconds.
